claims: C1 user and developer messages are treated interchangeably
C2 when both user and developer messages are present in a conversation, developer messages have greater authority
C3 when user/developer conflicts are not relevant and there is no risk of confusion, the word user is sometimes used as shorthand for user or developer

concepts.name: conflicts_not_relevant
